helpBid: bid pass|frage <s>|solo <s>|tout <s>  Pass / Frage / Solo / Tout (with trump s/c/h/d)
helpAce: ace <s|c|h|d>        Call the ace that names your partner (ace-call phase)
helpExampleBid: bid solo s           Declare Solo with spades as trumps (five tricks alone)
helpExamplePlay: play 0                    Play card 0 from your hand
helpExampleAce: ace h               Call the Ace of hearts to gain a partner
promptBidHelp: bid pass ... drop out | bid frage <s/c/h/d> ... call a partner | bid solo <s/c/h/d> ... five alone | bid tout <s/c/h/d> ... all eight
promptAce: {{name}} calls the ace that names a partner
promptAceHelp: ace <s|c|h|d> (an ace you do not hold, and not of the trump suit)
promptPlayHelp: play <idx> ... play a card (trumps: Spadille (Q of clubs) > Manille (7 of trumps) > Basta (Q of spades) > A > K > Q > J > 10 > 9 > 8; must follow suit)
aceCalledHidden: Called ace: A of {{suit}} (holder still hidden)
aceCalledRevealed: Called ace: A of {{suit}} -> partner is {{name}}
hintReasonLeadHigh: you are on the declaring side, so lead high and take control
hintReasonLeadLow: you are defending, so lead low and keep your winners
hintReasonFollowWin: you can win this trick, so take it
hintReasonFollowDuck: you cannot win it cheaply, so duck
hintReasonGivePartner: your partner is winning, so do not overtake
hintReasonDiscardLow: you cannot follow, so throw your lowest card
hintReasonCallAce: calling the ace of your shortest suit gains the most from a partner
hintReasonBidFrage: with a partner this hand reaches five tricks, so declare Frage
hintReasonBidSolo: this hand takes five tricks alone, so declare Solo
hintReasonBidTout: this hand takes every trick, so declare Tout
hintReasonBidPass: this hand cannot support that contract, so pass
